title: PhoneValue-Bench: A Dual-Ground-Truth Scorecard Benchmark for Smartphone Recommerce Inspection
abstract: arXiv:2611.00791v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Remote smartphone recommerce is scaling quickly, and locking a repurchase offer from seller photos and diagnostic screens before the handset arrives has become a central operational task. Existing multimodal resources mainly target defect localization, catalog attributes, or screen reading. They overlook payout-facing scorecards with dual cosmetic and operational ground truth under a declared input contract. This gap stems from two challenges: (1) the lack of a large weakly labeled trade-in corpus kept separate from a compact audited ranking cut, and (2) architectures that either flatten unordered photo bags into one prompt or collapse evaluation into a single price scalar. To address these challenges, we propose PhoneValue-Bench, a dual-ground-truth recommerce framework with PhoneValue-Corpus for weak training on 21,550 orders and 278,748 images, and PV-Rank as the only leaderboard on 335 quality-gated orders. translated_title: PhoneValue-Bench：面向智能手机二手回收检测的双真值记分卡基准
translated_abstract: 远程智能手机二手回收交易正在迅速扩张，在手机送达之前，根据卖家提供的照片和诊断屏幕锁定回购报价已成为一项核心运营任务。现有的多模态资源主要针对缺陷定位、目录属性或屏幕阅读，忽视了在规定输入契约下、具有外观与运行状态双重真值且面向支付结算的记分卡任务。这一空白源于两大挑战：（1）缺乏大规模弱标注的以旧换新语料库，且该语料库需与紧凑的经审核排名子集相分离；（2）现有架构要么将无序的照片集合压平为单一提示，要么将评估坍缩为单一价格标量。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了PhoneValue-Bench——一个双真值二手回收评测框架，其中包含用于弱监督训练的PhoneValue-Corpus（涵盖21,550个订单和278,748张图像），以及作为唯一排行榜的PV-Rank（基于335个经质量把关的订单）。系统排名……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出PhoneValue-Bench，首个面向智能手机二手回收检测的双真值（外观与运行状态）记分卡基准，包含21,550个订单、278,748张图像的弱标注训练语料库，以及基于335个经质量审核订单的PV-Rank排行榜。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PhoneValue-Bench, the first dual-ground-truth (cosmetic and operational) scorecard benchmark for smartphone recommerce inspection, comprising a weakly labeled training corpus of 21,550 orders with 278,748 images and the PV-Rank leaderboard built on 335 quality-gated orders.
